summary: Iteration 3 validates the new Dice game, Casino Game History, and the Provably-Fair commit/reveal/verify flow. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass (12 regression + 12 new in test_fairness.py) — Dice mechanics (over/under + exact multipliers 1.98/3.96), bad target/direction/insufficient 400s, auth 401, /casino/seed GET returns 64-char hash + client_seed + nonce + revealed[], /casino/seed/client persists via GET round-trip, /casino/seed/rotate reveals a seed whose sha256 matches the committed hash and resets nonce to 0, history rows include fair fields (nonce/server_seed_hash/client_seed) and never leak Mongo _id, and we independently recompute Dice and Limbo results from the revealed seed and prove exact bit-match. Frontend (Playwright, admin logged in): /casino/dice renders defaults (target 50, over, chance 50%, mult 1.9800×); switching to target 25 over -> chance 75%/mult 1.32×; under -> 25%/3.96×; dice-play-button rolls (e.g. 91.53 WIN 19.8 USDT, 2.23 LOSS), dice-roll-marker and dice-result both render. Casino lobby -> casino-history-open -> casino-history-modal: history tab lists 40 rows with per-row casino-verify-<id>. Fairness tab shows fairness-server-hash (64 chars), fairness-client-seed-input accepts & persists a custom seed after fairness-save-client-seed, fairness-rotate-button rotates (hash changes, fairness-revealed-list grows to 11 revealed seeds). Verify BEFORE rotate renders no verify-result and the UI surfaces the 'rotate first' toast; after rotate casino-verify-result-<id> renders '✓ Verified · roll 70.42 · hash ok'. Regression: limbo-play-button, plinko-play-button, keno-play-button, mines-start-button -> mines-tile -> mines-cashout-button all deduct stake and credit payout (Mines cashed out 11.25 USDT @ 1.125×).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~947 lines — casino + fairness logic (next_fair/rfloat/pick_distinct/limbo_result/mines_multiplier/dice/seed endpoints) should be extracted into /app/backend/routers/casino.py and /app/backend/services/fairness.py for maintainability.

fair_meta() returns {'nonce','server_seed_hash','client_seed'} and is stored on every casino_games doc, which is correct for independent verification. Consider also storing the game's input params explicitly at top level (target, direction) for Dice — currently they live only inside 'detail', which is fine but mines-cashout omits the fair meta's 'nonce' key check (uses g.get('nonce'), safe but worth typing).

pre-rotate verify UX: clicking casino-verify-<id> on a game whose server seed hasn't been revealed yet does nothing visible except a transient toast — consider rendering a persistent amber state in casino-verify-result-<id> like 'Awaiting reveal (rotate seed to verify)' so the UI is self-explanatory.

Dice slider range is 2..98 (step 1) in Dice.jsx but backend allows 0.01..99.99 — the extra precision isn't reachable from the UI. Either widen the slider or tighten the backend validator so docs/UI/API agree.
mines/start now refunds the prior active game's stake (good — addresses iteration_2 comment). The old regression test asserted the old no-refund behavior; updated test_casino.py accordingly.
